datasets.title: Southwest Egholm - waveHeight
datasets.resolution: Approximately 1 km (1/100 degree latitude x 1/60 degree longitude); hourly forecast
limitations: Regional forecast, not a measured wave series or return-period design extreme.
WAM includes shallow-water processes but does not include sea-current interaction.
Significant wave height and mean/peak period must not be silently treated as a regular-wave engineering load case.
Direction convention must be verified before directional load analysis.

gaps.title: Contemporary Egholm oxygen at crop and seabed
gaps.reason: Near-Egholm1989-1997 and regional2024-2025 surface records were extracted, but no contemporary local Egholm oxygen series. Do not infer oxygen from chlorophyll or turbidity.
gaps.nextStep: Obtain site-specific vertical observations and verify seasonal low-oxygen events.

gaps.title: Local wave validation and storm extremes
gaps.reason: DMI WAM forecast acquired at approximately 1 km. No local observations or long-term extreme-value analysis. Open-Meteo query returned all nulls.
gaps.nextStep: Wave observations and a site-calibrated model for design extremes.

gaps.title: Long-term local current climatology
gaps.reason: New hourly forecast resolves reversal over several days but cannot supply seasonal or return-period statistics.

gaps.title: LAT to DVR90 transformation
